questions.q: What white markings did Black Beauty have?
choices: One white foot and a white star on his forehead
Four white socks and a white blaze on his nose
A white tail and a white patch on his left side
A white stripe running all the way down his back
questions.evidence: I had one white foot and a pretty white star on my forehead

questions.q: How old was Black Beauty when Squire Gordon came to look at him?
choices: Four years old
Two years old
Three years old
Six years old
questions.evidence: When I was four years old Squire Gordon came to look at me

questions.q: In this chapter, what does "breaking in" a horse mean?
choices: Teaching a horse to wear saddle and bridle and obey
Breaking a horse's spirit with a whip until it gives in
Letting a young horse break out of its stable at night
Teaching a horse to race fast on the open common
questions.evidence: It means to teach a horse to wear a saddle and bridle

questions.q: Why did the master decide to break in Black Beauty himself?
choices: He did not want him to be frightened or hurt
He wanted to save the money a trainer would cost
Squire Gordon had asked him to do it that way
None of the men on the farm knew how to do it
questions.evidence: as he should not like me to be frightened or hurt

questions.q: How did Black Beauty feel about the bit when it was first put in his mouth?
choices: He thought it was a nasty, very bad thing
He liked the taste of the cold steel bar
He hardly noticed it was there at all
He thought it was fun to chew and play with

questions.q: What helped Black Beauty get used to wearing the bit and bridle?
choices: Nice oats and his master's pats and kind words
Being whipped by old Daniel every time he refused
Watching the cows wear bridles in the next field
Being left alone in the field for a few weeks
questions.evidence: what with the nice oats, and what with my master's pats, kind words, and gentle ways

questions.q: Which came after the bit and bridle in Black Beauty's training?
choices: The saddle
Seeing his first train go by
Being sold to Squire Gordon
Meeting Merrylegs and Ginger

questions.q: Which piece of harness did Black Beauty hate because it doubled up his tail?
choices: The crupper
The blinkers
The collar
The girth
Side-pieces on the bridle so he could not see sideways
Lamps on the front of a carriage for driving at night
Iron shoes nailed onto his feet by the blacksmith
Straps that went under his tail to hold the saddle
questions.evidence: great side-pieces against my eyes called blinkers

questions.q: How did Black Beauty react the very first time a train went by?
choices: He galloped to the far side of the meadow, snorting
He went on eating quietly beside the cows and sheep
He jumped clean over the fence and ran down the lane
He trotted right up to the train to see what it was
questions.evidence: I turned and galloped to the further side of the meadow

questions.q: Why did the master send Black Beauty to a farm next to the railway?
choices: So he would learn not to be afraid of trains
So he could eat the better grass growing there
So he could be broken in to harness by the farmer
So the farmer could look him over and buy him
questions.evidence: I am as fearless at railway stations as in my own stable

questions.q: What did Black Beauty's mother say about foolish, careless men?
choices: They spoil more horses than all, for want of sense
They make the kindest masters because they never worry
They hardly ever own horses, so they do little harm
They always carry whips but are too lazy to use them
questions.evidence: these spoil more horses than all, just for want of sense
